name: ehr-sync
description: EHR Sync — scaffold for a FHIR/EHR to Oracle synchronization platform

scripts.dev:python: cd apps/python && uv run python -m app.main
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace apps/web && npm run build --workspace apps/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace apps/web && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/api
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace apps/api --if-present && npm run test --workspace apps/web --if-present
scripts.check:python: cd apps/python && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run mypy app
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run prisma:validate && npm run check:python
